subject: Request: Pilot window buffer due to integration lull
messages:
From: Eddy Tran <eddy@nimbleworks.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: sana@nimbleworks.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot timing — need a short buffer

Hi Priyom,

Quick note from our side: engineering ran into an unexpected serialization bug in the payment adapter that will take us one to two sprints to stabilize. We were hoping to kick off the Redwood pilot next week, but the team is asking to push the pilot start by ~6 weeks so they can finish the adapter tests and an internal security review.

We love the product and want to keep momentum — would NimbleWorks be eligible for a short trial-extension and a small credits top-up while we finish integrating? Having a buffer will let us run the pilot with the intended scope rather than a cut-down test.

Attached is a brief integration log and the current backlog notes for context. Happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Thanks,

— Eddy
Eddy Tran
Head of Integrations, NimbleWorks
eddy@nimbleworks.com

Attachments:
- integration-log.txt (excerpt)
- backlog-summary.md (referenced)

From: priyom.das@redwood.com <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Eddy Tran <eddy@nimbleworks.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timing — need a short buffer

Eddy — thanks for the heads up and for the log. Sorry to hear you hit the serialization bug. We want the pilot to demonstrate the full integration, not a hacked-down version.

Two quick asks so I can make the case internally:
- Can your engineers share a short note (1-2 bullets) on the blocker and an expected completion date?
- Do you want a 45 or 60 day buffer from the original start date? We can propose either to our pilot policy team.

Marissa is cc'd — she owns approvals. Dev, can you confirm if this kind of delay typically maps to a credits top-up + extension, or would you recommend only time extension?

If you prefer, we can also schedule a 30-min call today to walk the stack.

Best,

Priyom Das
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0123

From: dev.patel@redwood.com <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, eddy@nimbleworks.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timing — need a short buffer

Quick technical summary from our eng side:

Thanks for sending the log, Eddy. From what I see this is a downstream serialization edge case where one vendor's SDK emits a field as null instead of an empty array under certain payloads. It blocks end-to-end validation and causes intermittent KV cache mismatches in our test harness.

Estimate to fix + test on your branch: ~10 business days if they prioritize the patch. If they need more runway, a 45-day extension should be sufficient for a full regression and the security review. On the credits side, if NimbleWorks sends a focused test plan (we can provide a template) we can offer a temporary sandbox credit allocation to keep the pilot data flowing while they fix it.

Suggested next step: Eddy — share the 1-paragraph blocker note and expected completion date and I’ll map to the template and propose the credit amount.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Eddy Tran <eddy@nimbleworks.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timing — need a short buffer

Hi Eddy — thanks for the context and to Dev for the quick tech read.

We can approve a conditional 45-day pilot extension and a one-time sandbox credit of $3,000 while you finish the fix. Conditions:
- NimbleWorks provides the 1-paragraph blocker note and a short test plan within 5 business days.
- We reserve the right to re-evaluate credits if we see misuse or a pivot in scope.

I’ve attached the signed extension approval PDF (extension-approval.pdf) and an updated pilot schedule (proposal_v2.pdf) that reflects the new timeline. Once you confirm acceptance I’ll sign the updated SOW and set the credits live.

If helpful I can also set up a joint engineering call for Monday.

Warmly,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0189

Attachments:
- extension-approval.pdf (signed)
- proposal_v2.pdf (updated timeline)

On Thu, 30 Jul 2026 at 08:04, Eddy Tran <eddy@nimbleworks.com> wrote:
> Thanks everyone — we’ll draft the blocker note this morning and share the test plan by EOD. Appreciate the quick response and the offer of credits.
>
> — Eddy
